# The Yuan princes' subject type "投下宗王" (Y5b phase 3, decision 299 item 4; audit 大元藩王与土司_现状与引擎_20261120.md 4.3).
# Given at run time by oe_yw_register (change_subject_type) to the members of the princes' line that are the Yuan's vassals;
# turned back into vassal when a prince leaves the line, at the Yuan's fall and by the test reset. Only script makes it.
# Cannot be annexed or cancelled by the overlord; declares no wars; limited diplomacy; follows the overlord into defensive
# wars; into offensive wars unasked only while the prince's loyalty tier in the line is loyal (country var oe_yw_tier 3),
# and it can be called unless estranged (tier 0). Pays and costs as a vanilla vassal. Keeps its own map colour.
oe_yw_touxia = {
